Name: Glyder - Adventure Worlds
Description: A gliding game about riding air currents across open worlds, collecting what floats there.

Achievements.Name: Barrelful
Achievements.Description: Collect 100 crystals.

Achievements.Name: High Altitude
Achievements.Description: Hit 1 km in altitude.

Achievements.Name: Long Flight
Achievements.Description: Fly continuously without landing or crashing for 4 minutes.

Achievements.Name: Crazy Fast
Achievements.Description: Reach terminal velocity.

Achievements.Name: Rookie Explorer
Achievements.Description: Complete any 5 extras in the progress log.

Achievements.Name: Sight Seeing
Achievements.Description: Complete any 3 challenges in the progress log.

Achievements.Name: Flight Master
Achievements.Description: Master the art of flying by completing Surface Skimmer, Entering Orbit and Take a Break! extras.

Achievements.Name: Friend to Squeebils
Achievements.Description: Help the Squeebils by completing all the Squeebil Challenges and Extras.

Achievements.Name: Raising the Dead
Achievements.Description: Mount all the Sun Flare Crystals to raise the temple in the bay and ignite the transphotonic beam.

Achievements.Name: Cold Front
Achievements.Description: Complete all goals, challenges and extras in Arctasia.

Achievements.Name: Reach New Heights
Achievements.Description: Complete all goals, challenges and extras in Spiral Heights.

Achievements.Name: Desert Hideaway
Achievements.Description: Complete all goals, challenges and extras in Oasis.

Achievements.Name: Spores and More
Achievements.Description: Complete all goals, challenges and extras in Sporelle.

Achievements.Name: Beat the Heat
Achievements.Description: Complete all goals, challenges and extras in Magma Core.

Achievements.Name: Cosmonaut
Achievements.Description: Complete all goals, challenges and extras in Ascension.

Achievements.Name: Ring Racer
Achievements.Description: Complete all goals, challenges and extras in Perpetua.

Achievements.Name: Crystal Collector
Achievements.Description: Collect all the blue, pink, and gold crystals.

Achievements.Name: World Traveler
Achievements.Description: Complete all challenges in the progress log.

Achievements.Name: Master Explorer
Achievements.Description: Complete all extras in the progress log.

Achievements.Name: Goal Getter
Achievements.Description: Complete all goals in the progress log.
